title: Extension Traits
summary: Add new methods to foreign types by defining and implementing a local trait.
lecture: Rust orphan rules prohibit implementing inherent methods directly on types from external crates or standard library.
To add methods to foreign types, define a trait in your crate and implement that trait for the target type.
Bringing the extension trait into scope enables calling the new method using standard dot notation.
